model_annotation: The pie chart represents the survey results regarding whether companies are currently integrating an algorithm to process human products. A total of 24 respondents expressed that they are integrating, which corresponds to 60% of the surveyed group. Twenty-five respondents stated that they are not currently integrating, equating to 62% of the total. The proportions for "Too good" and "Just as good" integration were 20.6% and 20% respectively, while only 4.4% of the respondents had no idea how the product is processed. There is no indication that any particular sector is visually emphasized or underlined in the chart. The chart does not provide any legend or text labels for the sectors, other than the percentages, making it challenging to determine category names or specific colors for each sector. The percentages are rounded to the nearest tenth and are inferred visually without any visible cross-sectional division within the sectors.
